children: ), formally SLM Corporation, today announced a 2026 fourth-quarter dividend on its Preferred Stock Series B of $1.4939647 per share. The company also announced a 2026 fourth-quarter dividend on its common stock of $0.13 per share.
Both preferred stock and common stock dividends will be paid on Dec. 15, 2026, to the respective stockholders of record at the close of business on Dec. 4, 2026.
